pulse.currentFocus: S373 closed eight S372 follow-ups with guards and tests; staging verified, production promotion awaits the founder.
pulse.nextMilestone: Decide the routine-content receipt binding (D-S373.3) and confirm the Lighthouse render-delay hypothesis.
blockers: Obelisk production enrolment is still invite-only (re-probed 2026-10-02: 403), so the site routes visitors to an invite request. Ark question to Obelisk pending since S367.

Edge uptime sampler cannot run: Workers Free caps the account at 5 cron triggers and all five belong to other projects. Cloudflare error 10072. Needs a founder to free a slot or move to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable — a challenge and a real edge outage are indistinguishable in them now the shape is gone. They are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.
Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Account signup acceptance, member newsletter arming, public-member-data and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

The Supabase service-role slot in the secrets gateway points at the sibling project (supabase-credential-project-mismatch). Row-data admin is degraded; management, SQL and edge-function deploy authority are live and were used this session.
api/founder-presence.json still carries 30 revisions in public git history. The purge needs crons disabled, a filter-repo rewrite and a force-push — CANON-019 founder action.

now: [SIL][S363][GATES/P2] Make `build:check` idempotent over `ignis/output/ecosystem-state.json` — DONE S365. The standalone runner now sanitizes the gitignored Oracle export before freezing and fingerprinting the tree, so a prior generator cannot strand step 81 on a rerun. This repaired a real closeout gate failure.

[SIL][S363][PROTOCOL/P1] Refuse an inbound propagation that removes an exported symbol this repo's own code imports. S363 merged back eight such symbols (D-S363.4), and S316 had already restored one of them and shipped cargo upstream so the next drain would carry it — it did not. Upstream cargo alone does not hold, so the recipient needs its own check: diff exported symbols pre/post drain and fail the drain, not the next build. Seven of the eight failed loudly as named imports; the eighth degraded silently and was caught only by a contract test, so detection is currently partly luck.

[SIL][S363][PROTOCOL/P2] Reconcile the four propagated checkers that encode studio-ops' own layout (D-S363.5, D-S363.7, D-S363.8, D-S363.9): `check-windows-hide` scan roots, the wipe guard's status-row format and archive naming, and `arc-profile.mjs` resolving `PROJECT_REGISTRY` to a path that exists only inside studio-ops. Each produced a false failure or a false inference that no local change could fix. Ark cargo `01K30UDB1264A040FE519B8D8B` carries the upstream ask; this item tracks whether the next drain actually lands it.

[S363][SIL/P3] Compact the agent memory index by hand (21.3KB, target <17.1KB). — DONE S372: 23.3KB → 12.1KB by moving the Gates/CI section verbatim into a topic sub-index (no labels shortened, zero links lost). An automated label-truncation pass was tried and reverted: shortening to a character budget inverted meanings ("Green run can deploy nothing" → "Green run can deploy"). Needs a deliberate pass that merges genuine near-duplicates (the two "receipts after final …" entries, the two skip-ci entries) and writes shorter labels that still carry the claim. A wrong recall hook is worse than a large index.

[S363][SAFETY/P0] The newsletter send gate keys on the mode, not the event — SHIPPED. A manual `workflow_dispatch` with `mode=send` skipped the hold entirely and would have mailed every opted-in member with `NEWSLETTER_ARMED` unset; the hold branch was also unreachable by any manual run. Now held whenever the effective mode is `send` and the variable is not `true` (D-S363.1). Nothing armed, nothing sent.

[S363][OBS/P1] The staleness probe can say "repaired, awaiting its next run" — SHIPPED. Reads the workflow source's commit time, so a streak whose every run predates the fix is `repaired-untested` with streak, commit and expiry named. Self-expires after one cadence; untouched workflows stay broken; a post-fix failure makes the streak real again; silence still reported. 9 self-test guards (D-S363.2).

[S363][TRUTH/P1] Supabase control-plane `overall` aggregates all four planes — SHIPPED. The public receipt read `blocked` while carrying three `ready` authorities and `readyPlanes: 3/4` beside it. Now `ready`/`partial`/`blocked` over all four, with live authorities named on the CLI. Promotion gate keys on `ready`, so nothing loosened (D-S363.3).

[S363][TRUTH/P1] The startup brief resolves revenue freshness through the shared resolver — SHIPPED. It parsed a studio-ops-only path, so it always printed `not found` while the doctor read it fine. `smoke-startup-scripts` 60/60 (D-S363.6).
next: [S348][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet — DONE. Every Desk story now links to a deterministic `critique.json` argument map joining stable fact receipts, stances, predictions, and hash-bound visual evidence. Unsupported claims stay explicitly `unlinked`; orphan cross-references fail closed; no runtime model call is made.
shipped: Shipped: 13 changes across 5 groups. Release truth: served-parity reporter; three data files on the content lane. Process: skip-CI body guard; non-interactive closeout refusal; clean-checkout verifier; per-session audit sidecar; redirect-target test. Checkout: LF pinned. Desk: satire 640 AVIF lane derivative and backfill; sized card art; mobile thumbnail and desktop placeholder fixes. Staging: `_redirects` emulation in the Worker.

Tests: unit 408 (0 failures, 1 todo), up from 388; new specs `s373-guards`, `s373-pages-redirects`, `desk-more-cards` (browser, 3/3, fails against the previous build); local build:check passes all 534 steps.

Deploy: staging only. Staging Worker 41746efa verified (16 of 16 routes match production). Production is unchanged this session; promotion of the Worker source and Desk content awaits the founder's go-ahead.

Receipt binding (founder-approved, D-S373.6): routine Desk content in a reviewed article is set aside only when the generator proves the page, the block digest is recorded, and drift is reported. Verified by a three-way drill on the real repository. Art and edition publishes no longer invalidate the visual receipt.

Not done 2: the Lighthouse flake, which now gates releases (the homepage tier reads recurring sub-floor; run 38027265643 failed at 5a8beccc5 on the homepage at 0.75 and one article at 0.89, the same profile as S372 and not caused by S373). CI result files show observed FCP equal to observed LCP with ten scripts finishing before it in every run, steady simulated FCP (1.3s) and swinging simulated LCP (2.3–3.9s). Direction: load below-the-fold Desk scripts after paint. Thresholds unchanged.
Carried: identity hold unchanged; Ark questions to studio-ops (visual-QA `.cache` classification, Supabase gateway slot) await replies.
